'''Gordan''' was the [[King/Legends|king]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kheedar]]. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] supporter who always considered Kheedar an Imperial holding, he was also senile. When the Empire arrived at Kheedar and declared martial law, he defied their approach in his senility and swore to fight. The [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Pestage (Victory-class)|''Pestage'']] used [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] to cow the planet and forced the world's surrender inside forty [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].
